svg.aria-label: Flame graphs of the detector before and after the optimisation
svg.title: whycode_vision: CPU per frame before and after, flame graphs
svg.text: Where the detector's CPU goes, before and after the optimisation
Flame graphs of the detector process replaying a 1280x720 warehouse lap (perf, task-clock, 499 Hz); a frame's width is its share of the lap's CPU time.
Before the optimisation: 5.4 ms of CPU a frame
Today's code: 1.3 ms a frame, on the same scale
